skirmish.module.fullbright.name: Fullbright
skirmish.module.fullbright.description: Brighter caves and nights: lighting is computed with a brightness above vanilla's maximum. Game options are not changed. The Darkness and Blindness effects still work as usual.
skirmish.module.fullbright.setting.stren: 10% is slightly above vanilla "Bright", 100% is fully lit
skirmish.module.fullbright.setting.key.t: Turn fullbright on or off (unbound by default)
